propositions: The reconciler hardcodes status != "Done" to identify active issues, which fails to exclude custom closed-equivalent statuses (Closed/Resolved/Cancelled) that exist in client workflows but map to the Done status category.

jql_active incorrectly pulls issues with non-literal Done statuses (e.g., Resolved/Closed) into the active working set, causing the reconciler to treat resolved issues as active and push outbound mutations at them.
jql_done_recent misses issues with custom Done-category statuses, so they never populate the recent-Done snapshot.

Switching the Done predicate from literal status = "Done" to statusCategory = Done / statusCategory != Done makes the query workflow-agnostic, since every Jira status maps to one of To Do / In Progress / Done categories.
